create_poisson_distribution: create a Poisson distribution with a given rate parameter tensor
sample_poisson_distribution: sample random nonnegative integers from a Poisson distribution with a specified rate
compute_poisson_log_prob: compute the log probability of observed values under a Poisson distribution
get_poisson_mean: get the mean of a Poisson distribution which equals its rate parameter
get_poisson_variance: get the variance of a Poisson distribution which equals its rate parameter
